_doc: Single source of truth: sprite id -> PNG. Swap art by replacing the PNG at 'path' (same size/frame layout) or by pointing 'path' at a new file. See docs/ART_GUIDE.md.

title_bg.note: 0.3.9 title background slot: drop Hudson's PNG here; until then ui/menu_bg is used. Cover-scaled, aspect kept.

_doc_facing: actors: the side sheet faces right ('flip' mirrors it for left); 'dir_paths' down/up are the front/back sheets with the same frames (0.3.9). Moving up shows the back, down the front.

roof.note: 3x3 nine-patch of 16px roof pieces, light neutral; tinted per town (data/towns roof)

arrow.note: 0.3.3 arrow projectile, drawn pointing right (rotated in flight)

autotile._doc: 0.3.9 autotile sheets: piece = N1|E2|S4|W8 (0..15), 16 '/' and 17 '\' diagonals; 'broken_row' 1 = deteriorated variants (rural fences only, ~15% by tile hash).

moat_border.note: 0..15 banks by connection mask, 16..19 bridge joins N E S W

moat_border_corners.note: 0.3.9.2 moat inner corners NE SE SW NW: both side neighbours are moat, the diagonal is land

_rules.doc: 0.3.9 a tile is overlaid by up to 2 higher-priority neighbouring floors; frame = edges(N1 E2 S4 W8) | corners(NW1 NE2 SE4 SW8)<<4 (corners only where both sides are not that floor). Water, walls and the moat never blend.
